The Centre for Independent Studies has a [Facebook](http://www.facebook.com/pages/The-Centre-for-Independent-Studies/155143154816 "Facebook") page that can be used to follow CIS media, publications and events.  The latest issue of *[Policy](http://www.cis.org.au/POLICY/spring09/spring09.html "Policy")* magazine is also available, including my [review essay](../../files/ackerlofshillerreview.pdf "review essay") on behavioural economics.
